documentKind.power-of-attorney: Names the person who decides for you
documentKind.combined: Names who decides for you and says what treatment you want

attribute.spouse: Your spouse or registered domestic partner
attribute.immediate-family: Your spouse, parent, child, grandchild, brother, or sister
attribute.relative-within-third-degree: A close relative of you or your spouse (parent, child, brother, sister, grandparent, grandchild, aunt, uncle, niece, nephew, or in-law)
attribute.blood-relative: Related to you by blood or adoption
attribute.relative-by-marriage: Related to you by marriage, such as an in-law or step-relative
attribute.relative: Related to you by blood, marriage, or adoption
attribute.heir: Someone who would inherit from you, under your will or by law
attribute.beneficiary: Someone who would gain money from your death, such as a life insurance beneficiary
attribute.creditor: Someone with a claim against your estate, such as a person you owe money
attribute.financially-responsible: Someone responsible for paying for your health care
attribute.attending-physician: Your doctor — the physician treating you
attribute.healthcare-provider: A health care provider who is treating you
attribute.provider-employee: An employee of your doctor or health care provider
attribute.facility-operator: An owner or operator of a hospital, nursing home, or care home where you are a patient or resident
attribute.facility-employee: An employee of a hospital, nursing home, or care home where you are a patient or resident
attribute.insurer-employee: An employee of your life or health insurance company
attribute.signed-for-principal: The person who signs the form for you, if you can't sign yourself

attributeQuestion.heir: Would inherit from me (in my will, or as close family by law)
attributeQuestion.beneficiary: Would gain money from my death (for example, life insurance)
attributeQuestion.creditor: Has a claim against my estate (for example, I owe them money)
attributeQuestion.financially-responsible: Pays for or is responsible for my health care
attributeQuestion.healthcare-provider: Is a health care provider treating me
attributeQuestion.provider-employee: Works for my doctor or health care provider
attributeQuestion.facility-operator: Owns or runs the hospital, nursing home, or care home where I am
attributeQuestion.facility-employee: Works at the hospital, nursing home, or care home where I am
attributeQuestion.insurer-employee: Works for my life or health insurance company
attributeQuestion.signed-for-principal: Will sign the form for me

relationship.cousin-or-distant: Cousin or more distant blood relative

rule.none-may-be: None of your witnesses can be:
rule.at-least-one-not: At least one of your witnesses must not be:
rule.at-most-one: Only one of your witnesses can be:

method.witnesses_one: Sign in front of {{count}} adult witness (age {{minAge}} or older). A notary is not needed.
method.witnesses_other: Sign in front of {{count}} adult witnesses (age {{minAge}} or older). A notary is not needed.
method.notary: Sign in front of a notary public. Witnesses are not needed.
method.witnesses-or-notary_one: Sign in front of {{count}} adult witness (age {{minAge}} or older) or a notary public. Either one works.
method.witnesses-or-notary_other: Sign in front of {{count}} adult witnesses (age {{minAge}} or older) or a notary public. Either one works.
method.witnesses-and-notary_one: Sign in front of {{count}} adult witness (age {{minAge}} or older) and a notary public, at the same time.
method.witnesses-and-notary_other: Sign in front of {{count}} adult witnesses (age {{minAge}} or older) and a notary public, at the same time.
method.signature-only: Sign and date it yourself. Witnesses and a notary are not required.

step.bring-id: Bring a photo ID. The notary needs to see it.
step.notary-recommended: A notary is optional, but notarizing can help the document be accepted.
step.agent-acceptance: Ask your {{agent}} to sign the acceptance section. They must do this before they can act for you.
step.witnesses-sign: Your witnesses sign right after you, in front of you and each other.

evaluation.tooYoung: Must be at least {{minAge}} years old.
evaluation.cannotBe: Can't be a witness because they are:
evaluation.needOneWho: At least one witness must not be:
evaluation.hintOther: Your other witness must not be:
